caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure dressed in a green tunic with yellow and red accents, a red skirt-like garment, ornate red-and-yellow boots, and a large, detailed blue-and-gray crown or helmet. The figure brandishes a long spear or sword in its raised right hand. Its left hand is pressed to its chest. The figure stands with one foot on a dark, four-limbed creature resembling a demon, which is laying on its back with its mouth open, showing a red tongue and white fangs. The base of the scene is grey and includes the inscription "SAN. MIGUEL" in black letters, with decorative flourishes on either end of the text. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional elements.
title: San Miguel - The Archangel and Satan
